item.title: Walpole filmmaker to attend Chatham screening April 13
item.description: The debut feature from Walpole Island First Nation filmmaker Eva Thomas has opened in select theatres and will include a Chatham screening.

item.title: Local hockey: Stonehouse scores at Frozen Four; Schives, Holmes at U Sports
item.description: Blenheim’s Abby Stonehouse scored for Penn State in a 4-3 overtime loss to Wisconsin in a Women’s Frozen Four semifinal.

item.title: Local roundup: Barnstormers re-sign Fukuda; Willimot wins Canadian bronze
item.description: The Chatham-Kent Barnstormers have re-signed all-star catcher Mitsuki Fukuda, their 2025 player of the year.

item.title: Employee pushed to ground during robbery: Chatham-Kent police
item.description: A stun gun was used to arrest a man following a violent robbery at a Chatham business Sunday afternoon, said Chatham-Kent police.

item.title: Chatham Maroons eager to rest and recover between playoff rounds
item.description: The Chatham Maroons swept the St. Thomas Stars in the first round of the GOHL playoffs.

item.title: 4 arrested after alleged armed Merlin home invasion: Chatham-Kent police
item.description: Four people are in custody after officers responded to an alleged home invasion involving a firearm here early Tuesday, Chatham-Kent police say.

item.title: Nearly one in four Chatham-Kent families facing food insecurity
item.description: Almost a quarter of households in Chatham-Kent struggle to afford food due to low income, the board of health heard Monday. According to data from Public Health Ontario collected in 2023-2024, 23.4 per cent of families in Chatham-Kent are food insecure. item.title: OHL commissioner talks expansion at Chatham-Kent council
item.description: With the Ontario Hockey League looking to expand in the coming years, Chatham-Kent councillors had a chance to hear from the league boss.
